decision_conditions: Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the extension is used.

Condition : 5 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the southern wall of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 7 - Tree Protection Methods:
	Details of the tree protection methods to be implemented in accordance with British Standard 5837 are to be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority prior to the commencement of any demolition or construction works on the site, and the development shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with any such approval.

Condition : 8 - Construction Operations:
A method statement detailing construction operations and procedures to obviate tree damage shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority prior to the commencement of any demolition or construction works on the site and the development shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with any such approval. The method statement shall include, but not be limited to, survey details of protection zones within which no building development shall take place and alternative construction methods that involve minimal digging.
description: Demolition of existing detached garage and erection of single storey side and part single storey rear extension to dwellinghouse. (Bedford Park Conservation Area)
